defects.title: Unmerged parallel line on branch new-version (6cbcdac, 7ac2a6c; 2026-11-09) with migrations 0052-0067 that collide with this branch's 0052-0057
defects.evidence: git log claude/new-session-xkd5g3..origin/new-version; both lines define documents, document_revisions, rfis and equipment differently; the migration runner refuses duplicate versions
defects.impact: About 21,000 lines of owner-authored work (revenue recognition, subcontracts, fixed assets, period end, payroll, consolidation, tax, workforce, HSE, quality, documents) are outside the candidate; neither line can be merged into main as it stands
defects.next_action: Integrate on this branch: renumber the non-colliding migrations after 0057, port transmittals/submittals, timesheets and HSE onto this branch's document and equipment tables, and run both lines' tests (ADR 0025)

defects.title: main is unprotected and at 1096bf2, which was merged while CI was failing
defects.evidence: GitHub branch listing (protected: false); docs/completion/GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_PACKAGE.md

defects.next_action: Repository administrator: branch protection with required checks and review (owner decision)
